bioconda.name: hormon
bioconda.summary: A tool for annotation of alpha satellite arrays in centromeres of a newly assembled human genome.
bioconda.description: HORmon infer human monomers based on the given alpha-satellite consensus template and centromeric sequence, extract HORs and decompose centromeric sequence into HORs.

commands: HORmon --help | grep -q "updating monomers to make it consistent with CE postulate"
